name: jm-stack
description: jm:stack: Lauren Tan's pstack for Claude Code and Codex with Josh Meads's model routing. Based on Open Pstack (ericlitman/open-pstack), which began from michael-denyer/pstack-claude and ports cursor/plugins/pstack. Skills are shared; tool names resolve via skills/poteto-mode/references/codex-tools.md.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous, parallelizable agent workflows: go deep first, write less, verify everything
interface.longDescription: jm:stack guides agent work through poteto-mode's principles, parallel design exploration (architect/arena), adversarial multi-model review (interrogate), root-cause debugging, prose deslopping, and verified delivery. Skills are shared with the Claude Code build; on Codex, tool names resolve via the codex-tools mapping.
interface.developerName: Lauren Tan (original), Open Pstack maintainers, Josh Meads
